#/texts/3.label: paragraph
#/texts/3.full_gt_text:
No. 55/1/1/88-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

#/texts/5.label: paragraph
#/texts/5.full_gt_text:
-----
The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from 25th June, 1988 -

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text: (1) Shri Narayan Datt Tiwari relinquished the office of the Minister of Finance and Minister of Commerce.

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text: (2) Prime Minister relinquished the office of Minister of External Affairs.

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text: (3) Shri P.V. Narasimha Rao relinquished the office of Minister of Human Resource Development and assumed the office of Minister of External Affairs.

#/texts/11.label: paragraph
#/texts/11.full_gt_text: (4) Shri P. Shiv Shanker relinquished the office of Minister of Planning and Minister of Programme Implementation and assumed the office of Minister of Human Resource Development.

#/texts/12.label: paragraph
#/texts/12.full_gt_text: (5) Shri Vasant Sathe, Minister of Energy relinquished the office of Minister of Communications.

#/texts/13.label: paragraph
#/texts/13.full_gt_text: (6) Shri Bindeshwari Dubey relinquished the office of Minister of Law and Justice and assumed the office of Minister of Labour.

#/texts/14.label: paragraph
#/texts/14.full_gt_text: (7) Shri Dinesh Singh relinquished the office of Minister of Water Resources and assumed the office of Minister of Commerce.

#/texts/15.label: paragraph
#/texts/15.full_gt_text: (8) Smt. Mohsina Kidwai, Minister of Urban Development relinquished the office of Minister of Tourism.

#/texts/16.label: paragraph
#/texts/16.full_gt_text: (9) Shri Moti Lal Vora, Minister of Health & Family Welfare relinquished the office of Minister of Civil Aviation.

#/texts/17.label: paragraph
#/texts/17.full_gt_text: (10) Shri Z.R. Ansari relinquished the office of the Minister of State (Independent charge) of the Ministry of Environment & Forests and assumed the office of Minister of Environment & Forests.

#/texts/18.label: paragraph
#/texts/18.full_gt_text: (11) Shri Jagdish Tytler relinquished the office of Minister of State (Independent charge) of the Ministry of Labour and assumed the office of Minister of State (Independent charge) of the Ministry of Food Processing Industries.

#/texts/19.label: paragraph
#/texts/19.full_gt_text: (12) Shri Shiv Raj Patil relinquished the office of Minister of State in the Departments of Defence Production and Supplies in the Ministry of Defence and assumed the office of Minister of State (Independent charge) of the Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism.
